description: Election Commission - K. M. Kumara was elected as the member of the Namaloya Pradeshiya Sabha, K. D. Bandusiri was elected as the member of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha, A. H. Deepika  was elected as the member of the election Commission
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to death and resignation, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies through a process managed by election officials. This falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
